findings.issue: The passage classifies rosemary with cacti as plants from desert regions. Kew describes rosemary habitat as dry Mediterranean scrubland, not a desert habitat. Use a clear desert example or describe the area as containing plants from dry regions, preserving the warm/dry contrast. Source: https://www.kew.org/plants/rosemary .

observations.issue: Several distractors are implausible or almost nonsensical in the role, e.g. bring Swimming teacher and Bring100people. They do not threaten unique keys but weaken discrimination even at this introductory stage.

The keyed fresh/short-transport inference is reasonable from fresh herbs and salad leaves plus short travel, but transport waste is less precise than the passage wording transport costs and packaging waste. Prefer that wording.
